what: served tokens carrying a grave on a syllable that is not the ultima, partitioned by source, edition and by what a repair could be pointed at

NOT_A_REPAIR_RULE.why: the mechanical repair, rewriting the stray varia as an oxia, gives the wrong word on several of the largest forms, and its target is itself attested, so an 'is the target attested' gate does not catch it. Four shapes are published per form and no single target column, deliberately.

counterexamples.ἐπεὶδὴ: ἐπειδὴ: the grave is dropped, not moved

syllable_test: vendored here rather than imported from greek-ocr, so the count cannot change with whether a sibling checkout exists; tests/test_nonfinal_grave.py asserts the two agree
